normalized.result: Both work for me, so either is acceptable. I slightly prefer Version A — "Show more bookmarks" adding to the list feels simpler and keeps everything in one flowing view, rather than flipping between pages. Version B's Next-page style is perfectly fine too. The important part for me is exactly what you assumed: my newest saves show up first, and when I search or filter it looks through my whole library, not just the bit currently on screen — otherwise I'd miss things. Let's go with Version A.
